project.name: Frontmend
project.summary: Frontmend turns a public website audit into a useful recommendation list and an evidence-rich brief a coding agent can act on.
project.ai_usage: WebMCP lets a compatible coding agent start and monitor the same audit as the human interface, then receive structured recommendations, exact evidence, repository search hints, and acceptance criteria without scraping the page.
project.codex_usage: Codex helped scope, implement, test, release-harden, and document the product, and is the repository-aware agent used in the primary workflow.
